import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class MinCostMaxFlow {
    static final int N = 10005, S = N - 2, T = N - 1;
    static final int M = 2000010;
    static final int INF = 2000000000;

    static int[] head = new int[N];
    static int[] to = new int[M];
    static int[] nxt = new int[M];
    static int[] cap = new int[M];
    static int[] cst = new int[M];
    static int edgeIdx = 1;

    static void addEdge(int u, int v, int capacity, int cost) {
        to[++edgeIdx] = v;
        nxt[edgeIdx] = head[u];
        head[u] = edgeIdx;
        cap[edgeIdx] = capacity;
        cst[edgeIdx] = cost;

        to[++edgeIdx] = u;
        nxt[edgeIdx] = head[v];
        head[v] = edgeIdx;
        cap[edgeIdx] = 0;
        cst[edgeIdx] = -cost;
    }

    static Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
    static long[] dist = new long[N];
    static boolean[] inQ = new boolean[N];

    static boolean spfa() {
        Arrays.fill(inQ, false);
        Arrays.fill(dist, Long.MAX_VALUE);
        q.clear();
        q.offer(T);
        dist[T] = 0;
        inQ[T] = true;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int x = q.poll();
            inQ[x] = false;
            for (int i = head[x]; i != 0; i = nxt[i]) {
                int y = to[i];
                if (cap[i ^ 1] > 0 && dist[y] > dist[x] + cst[i ^ 1]) {
                    dist[y] = dist[x] + cst[i ^ 1];
                    if (!inQ[y]) {
                        q.offer(y);
                        inQ[y] = true;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return dist[S] < Long.MAX_VALUE;
    }

    static long dfs(int x, int flowLimit, long[] totalCost) {
        long flow = 0;
        inQ[x] = true;
        if (x == T) return flowLimit;
        for (int i = head[x]; i != 0; i = nxt[i]) {
            int y = to[i];
            if (cap[i] == 0 || inQ[y]) continue;
            if (dist[x] != dist[y] + cst[i]) continue;
            long t = dfs(y, Math.min(cap[i], flowLimit - flow), totalCost);
            cap[i] -= t;
            cap[i ^ 1] += t;
            flow += t;
            totalCost[0] += t * cst[i];
            if (flow == flowLimit) break;
        }
        inQ[x] = false;
        return flow;
    }

    static long minCostMaxFlow() {
        int totalFlow = 0;
        long totalCost = 0;
        while (spfa()) {
            Arrays.fill(inQ, false);
            totalFlow += dfs(S, 101, new long[]{totalCost});
        }
        return totalCost;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int m = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int c = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int d = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int limit = 101;

        Arrays.fill(head, 0);
        edgeIdx = 1;

        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int x = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine()) - 1;
            addEdge(S, x, 1, 0);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < limit; i++) {
            addEdge(i * n, T, k, c * i);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < limit - 1; j++) {
                addEdge(i + j * n, i + (j + 1) * n, k, 0);
            }
        }

        for (int _ = 0; _ < m; _++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            int x = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken()) - 1;
            int y = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken()) - 1;
            for (int i = 0; i < limit - 1; i++) {
                for (int j = k - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
                    addEdge(x + i * n, y + (i + 1) * n, 1, d * (j * 2 + 1));
                    addEdge(y + i * n, x + (i + 1) * n, 1, d * (j * 2 + 1));
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(minCostMaxFlow());
    }
}
